description.value: A family-owned and operated motel in Port Alberni's Alberni Valley, offering a range of room types from standard kitchenette rooms to two-bedroom cottages. The property sits near a riverside walkway where bears can be spotted fishing in late summer and fall, giving it an unmistakably wild Vancouver Island character. It is centrally located within minutes of the Clutesi Haven Marina and several local restaurants.

The amenities section lists 'Free WiFi' and room descriptions repeat 'complimentary parking and wifi,' confirming Wi-Fi. The website names several nearby restaurants (The Clam Bucket, Bucksnorts Bar and Grill, Boomerangs Cafe, Little Bavaria Restaurant), confirming nearby evening food. No mention of bike storage, laundry, tools, or any cyclist-specific infrastructure appears anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating motel with an active website, confirmed contact details, and clear room offerings — straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists passing through Port Alberni.
